
```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
sb_protected_areas <- st_read(here("discussion", "data", "week3data", "cpad_super_units_sb.shp")) |>  
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_city_boundaries <- st_read(here("discussion", "data", "week3data", "sb_city_boundaries_2003.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_county_boundary <- st_read(here("discussion", "data", "week3data", "sb_county_boundary_2020.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

aves <- st_read(here("discussion", "data", "week3data", "aves_observations_2020_2024.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")
```

## Find bird observations within PAs in Santa Barbara County
Find how many bird observations are within protected areas in Santa Barbara County and show how your output differs with a spatial subset versus a spatial join

```{r}
aves_PA_subset <- sb_protected_areas[aves, ] # Subset the protected areas with birds
nrow(aves_PA_subset) # 35 rows
```

```{r}
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(aves_PA_subset) +
    tm_dots(col = "#023047")
```

Join all bird observations and protected areas
```{r}
aves_PA_join <- st_join(aves, sb_protected_areas)

nrow(aves_PA_join) # 500 rows
```

Inner join
```{r}
aves_PA_inner <- st_join(aves, sb_protected_areas, left = FALSE)

nrow(aves_PA_inner)
```

Make a 5 km buffer around the protected areas and subset buffered geometries to only those with bird observations

```{r}
# Set 5 km buffer around protected areas
PA_buffer_5km <- st_buffer(sb_protected_areas, dist = units::set_units(5, "km"))

# Subset buffered areas to only those with bird observation
aves_PA_buffer_subset <- PA_buffer_5km[aves,]

# Check rows
nrow(aves_PA_buffer_subset)
```

```{r}
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(aves_PA_buffer_subset) +
    tm_dots(col = "#023047")
```

## Find PAs within 15 km of Goleta
```{r}
# Subset SB county to Goleta
goleta <- sb_city_boundaries |> 
    dplyr::filter(NAME == "Goleta")

# Check if units are in meters
st_crs(goleta)$units 

# Create 15 km buffer around Goleta
goleta_buffer_15km <- st_buffer(goleta, dist = 15000) 
```


```{r}
goleta_PA_within <- st_within(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km)

goleta_PA_intersect <- st_intersects(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km)

goleta_PA_intersection <- st_intersection(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km)

sum(lengths(goleta_PA_within) > 0)
sum(lengths(goleta_PA_intersect) > 0)
nrow(goleta_PA_intersection)
```

## Find distance between Goleta and Dangermond Preserve

```{r}
dangermond <- sb_protected_areas |> 
    filter(UNIT_NAME == "Jack and Laura Dangermond Preserve")

danger_dist <- st_distance(goleta, dangermond)
danger_dist
```

```{r}
danger_centroid <- st_centroid(dangermond)
goleta_centroid <- st_centroid(goleta)

danger_dist_centroid <- st_distance(danger_centroid, goleta_centroid)
```

```{r}
danger_dist == danger_dist_centroid # FALSE 
```
